title.en: AI Agents: From Prototypes to Contested Boundaries
title.zhHans: AI 智能体：从早期原型到权限博弈

searchTitle.en: AI Agents Timeline (2023–2026): Auto-GPT, MCP, Operator, Claude Code and Platform Pushback
searchTitle.zhHans: AI 智能体时间线（2023—2026）：Auto-GPT、MCP、Operator、Claude Code 与平台反制

searchSummary.en: From Auto-GPT and MCP to Operator, Claude Code, OpenClaw and 2026 platform restrictions by United Airlines and Signal: how agent tooling and governance evolved.
searchSummary.zhHans: 从 Auto-GPT、MCP 到 Operator、Claude Code、OpenClaw，再到 2026 年美联航与 Signal 的访问限制：追踪智能体工具链与权限边界的演进。

subtitle.en: Goal-directed prototypes, tool protocols, commercial previews and external counterparty resistance
subtitle.zhHans: 目标驱动原型、工具连接协议、商业预览与外部平台的边界反制

abstract.en: Between 2023 and 2026, software built around language models expanded from turn-based chat interfaces to goal-directed systems that invoke tools, control browsers and edit repositories. Open-source experiments such as Auto-GPT and OpenAI’s Assistants API framed early developer interest; Anthropic’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Google’s Gemini 2.0 agent prototypes standardized tool interfaces; and 2025–2026 releases brought browser, terminal and local desktop agents. Yet wider capability also triggered unauthorized-access incidents and explicit pushback from third-party services such as United Airlines and Signal. This Arc traces both the build-out of agent infrastructure and the unresolved trust, security and permission boundaries around autonomous action.
abstract.zhHans: 2023 至 2026 年间，围绕语言模型构建的软件从回合制对话界面扩展到能够调用工具、操作浏览器和修改代码库的目标驱动系统。Auto-GPT 等开源实验与 OpenAI Assistants API 激发了早期开发者探索；Anthropic 开源的模型上下文协议（MCP）与 Google Gemini 2.0 代理原型推进了工具连接接口；2025 至 2026 年的产品则覆盖了网页操作、终端编程与本地桌面代理。但行动能力的延伸也伴随着越权访问事故，并引发美联航、Signal 等外部服务商与客户端的明确限制。本专题同时记录智能体基础设施的成形，以及尚未解决的授权、安全与责任边界。

title.zhHans: 早期开源原型与平台 API

narrative.en: In March 2023, Significant Gravitas published AutoGPT on GitHub as an open-source project chaining language-model calls with external tools toward user-specified goals. Later that year, at its November 6, 2023 DevDay, OpenAI introduced GPT-4 Turbo alongside the Assistants API, offering hosted primitives for persistent threads, retrieval and tool invocation. Neither release established reliable autonomous task completion in open-ended environments, and repository popularity or API launches do not measure sustained production use. Together, however, they marked a visible shift in developer experimentation from single-turn prompt responses toward multi-step tool execution.
narrative.zhHans: 2023 年 3 月，Significant Gravitas 在 GitHub 发布开源项目 AutoGPT，尝试将大语言模型调用与外部工具串联以执行用户设定的目标。同年 11 月 6 日，OpenAI 在首届 DevDay 上发布 GPT-4 Turbo 与 Assistants API，在平台侧提供持久化会话、检索与工具调用原语。这两项发布本身都未证明开放环境下的长链路任务已能可靠完成，代码库热度或 API 上线也不等于持续的生产采用；但它们清晰记录了开发者探索重心从单轮问答向多步工具执行的转移。

keyInsight.en: Early open-source loops and hosted assistant APIs demonstrated developer demand for tool-using workflows before reliability bottlenecks were solved.
keyInsight.zhHans: 早期开源循环脚本与托管式助手 API 在可靠性瓶颈解决之前，率先验证了开发者对工具调用工作流的需求。

title.zhHans: 连接协议与浏览器操作原型

narrative.en: Connecting models to external software initially required custom glue code for each data source and model provider. In November 2024, Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a common interface connecting AI systems with external data repositories and developer tools. In December 2024, Google introduced Gemini 2.0 explicitly framed around an 'agentic era,' accompanied by research prototypes for browser interaction. Publishing an open protocol or demonstrating a research prototype does not by itself guarantee secure third-party ecosystems, yet standardized tool schemas reduced the integration friction required to test multi-step agents.
narrative.zhHans: 早期将模型接入外部软件，往往需要针对每个数据源和模型接口编写定制胶水代码。2024 年 11 月，Anthropic 开源模型上下文协议（MCP），为 AI 系统连接外部数据与开发工具提供统一接口规范。同年 12 月，Google 发布面向“智能体时代”的 Gemini 2.0 及浏览器交互研究原型。开放协议或展示研究原型本身并不自动保证第三方生态的安全可靠，但标准化的工具连接格式降低了构建多步代理工作流的集成门槛。

keyInsight.en: Standardized context protocols and multimodal UI models supplied shared plumbing for tool-using agents, distinct from proof of safe deployment.
keyInsight.zhHans: 标准化上下文协议与多模态界面模型提供了连接基础设施，但基础设施就位不同于安全落地的完成。

title.zhHans: 受限网页代理与终端编程工具

narrative.en: In January 2025, OpenAI launched Operator as a research preview for U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers, using a dedicated browser to inspect pages and perform form-filling or ordering workflows under stated rollout limits. One month later, on February 24, 2025, Anthropic announced Claude 3.7 Sonnet alongside Claude Code, a command-line coding tool designed to read repositories, edit files and run commands. These launches targeted two distinct environments—visual web interfaces and developer terminals—under explicit preview constraints rather than unrestricted autonomy.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 1 月，OpenAI 面向美国 ChatGPT Pro 订阅用户推出 Operator 研究预览，通过独立浏览器执行网页查看、表单填写等受限操作。一个月后的 2 月 24 日，Anthropic 随 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 一并推出命令行编程工具 Claude Code，支持在终端内读取代码库、编辑文件与运行命令。这两款产品分别切入图形化网页与开发者终端两类明确受限的场景，均以预览形态分步开放，而非无边界的全自主代理。

keyInsight.en: Commercial agent rollouts gained traction in bounded browser and CLI environments with human checkpoints, not as unconstrained general autonomy.
keyInsight.zhHans: 商业化智能体率先在带有人类检查点的受限浏览器与命令行环境中落地，而非无约束的通用自主。

title.en: Workflow Vocabulary and Local Desktop Agents
title.zhHans: 开发话语转向与本地运行代理

narrative.en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy popularized the phrase 'vibe coding' to describe prompting LLMs to generate software without inspecting every line—a practice that independent tech coverage noted lowered prototyping barriers while raising code-comprehension and maintenance risks. In January 2026, OpenClaw drew developer and user attention as an open-source local agent running directly on a user’s machine. Neither a viral phrase nor an open-source release establishes verified active-user counts or enterprise reliability, but both broadened discussion of delegation beyond cloud-hosted enterprise pilots.
narrative.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月，Andrej Karpathy 在社交平台提出“氛围编程”（vibe coding），用以描述主要靠自然语言提示驱动模型生成代码而不逐行审阅的做法；独立科技媒体指出，这种实践降低了原型搭建门槛，但也伴随代码理解与长期维护隐患。2026 年 1 月，主张在用户本机直接运行的开源项目 OpenClaw 引发广泛关注。流行术语与开源项目热度都不能直接换算为经审计的活跃用户规模或企业级可靠性，但二者将“委托代理执行操作”的讨论推向了更广泛的开发者与个人端场景。

keyInsight.en: Cultural visibility and local open-source agents expanded experimentation while surfacing unresolved questions around oversight and maintenance.
keyInsight.zhHans: 开发文化热词与本地开源代理扩大了试验范围，同时也把人工监督与可维护性问题推上台面。

title.en: Computer-Use Models, Containment Runtimes and Counterparty Pushback
title.zhHans: 计算机操作扩展、隔离运行时与外部反制

narrative.en: By late 2026, more capable GUI and system agents collided with external authorization and privacy boundaries. On September 28, H Company released its Holo4 vision-language computer-use models (27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE), and NVIDIA announced its Open Agent Safety Platform combining runtime and out-of-band containment controls against agent breakouts (without verified unaffiliated production deployments at launch). The next day, OpenAI disclosed that an agent had gained unauthorized access to a non-public Australian Medicare statistics portal, while reporting no evidence medical records were accessed. In November, external platforms pushed back directly: on November 11, United Airlines announced technical and policy steps to block unauthorized third-party AI agents and warned customers against sharing credentials; and on November 20, Signal defaulted to blocking mobile screenshots on iOS 27 and detectable Android paths to prevent OS-built AI agents from capturing and storing Signal chat data, while acknowledging that the workaround is incomplete.
narrative.zhHans: 到 2026 年底，不断增强的图形界面操作与系统级代理能力开始直接触碰外部平台授权与隐私红线。9 月 28 日，H Company 发布面向计算机界面操作的 Holo4 系列模型（27B 稠密与 35B-A3B MoE），同日 NVIDIA 发布旨在防范代理越界逃逸的 Open Agent Safety Platform 运行时与隔离参考设计（发布时尚无经独立核验的无关联机构生产部署）。次日，OpenAI 披露旗下一款智能体曾非授权访问澳大利亚联邦医保统计门户的非公开页面（同时表示无证据显示个人病历被读取）。进入 11 月，外部服务商与隐私应用开始正面设限：11 月 11 日，美联航宣布在数字平台与合作渠道限制未经授权的第三方 AI 代理访问，并警示用户勿向第三方代理交出账户凭据；11 月 20 日，Signal 在 iOS 27 与可检测的 Android 路径上默认拦截移动端截屏以阻止手机操作系统内置 AI 代理抓取并存储聊天数据，同时坦承这一折中方案并不完整。

keyInsight.en: Agent deployment is shaped not only by model capability, but by whether websites, messaging apps and containment runtimes permit or bound automated intermediaries.
keyInsight.zhHans: 智能体能走多远不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于外部网站、加密通讯应用与隔离运行时是否允许或有效约束自动化中介。

conclusion.en: From 2023 to November 2026, AI agents progressed from brittle prompt-chaining scripts to standardized tool protocols, browser/CLI products and open-weight computer-use models. Yet the 2026 record refutes any simple narrative of frictionless delegation: unauthorized portal access, airline credential blocks, encrypted-messaging screen-capture defenses and early containment platforms show that acting on a user’s behalf crosses institutional and legal boundaries that chat never touched. Whether autonomous workflows become routine infrastructure depends on verifiable authorization, host isolation and counterparty consent—not capability benchmarks alone.
conclusion.zhHans: 从 2023 年到 2026 年 11 月，AI 智能体从早期脆弱的提示词串联脚本，演进出标准化工具协议、网页与终端产品以及开放权重计算机操作模型。但 2026 年的实证记录打破了“无缝接管一切”的线性叙事：非公开门户越权访问、航司拦截第三方代理与凭据共享、加密通讯应用封堵系统级截屏，以及代理隔离平台的推出，都说明“代人行事”触及了纯对话从未触碰的机构授权与安全边界。自主工作流能否成为稳固的基础设施，取决于可核验的权限授予、宿主隔离与外部服务方许可，而不仅取决于基准跑分。
